display.purpose: The hero hook only; Barlow Semi Condensed 600, balanced, at most 24ch, Ink with the final clause in Sage Deep.

headline.purpose: Every bay h2; Ink on sage and on paper, at most 22ch.

quote.purpose: The epigraph band on the curtain, centred in 40rem.

page-title.purpose: The h1 of each inner page, directly on the curtain, at most 16ch.

row-term.purpose: The dt of definition rows and the title of each homepage door row.

phone-big.purpose: The oversized call link on the contacts page.

button.purpose: Every pill label; Barlow Semi Condensed 600 in sentence case.

lead.purpose: First paragraph of a bay; the one sentence a green bay may carry.

body.purpose: All prose on paper at a 66ch measure.

label.purpose: h3, nav, text links, plate titles, attributions; always uppercase and tracked, never on buttons.

label-small.purpose: Photo captions, brand role, place line, period tags.

numeral.purpose: Steps counters on terapie.html in Sage Deep on paper.

shadows.name: paper-lift
shadows.purpose: Sheets lifted off the curtain; the slip uses the first term only.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary pill at rest; hover deepens to 0 16px 28px -12px rgba(23,44,84,0.7) with the same inset.

shadows.name: rail-drop
shadows.purpose: Sticky rail; the action bar mirrors it as 0 -10px 24px -14px.

shadows.name: curtain-edge
shadows.purpose: Gathered inner edge of the left curtain half; mirrored (-14px) on the right.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing; used for transforms, shadows and the curtain.

motion.name: curtain-open
motion.value: 1.5s ease-out 0.35s both; translateX(0) to translateX(±92%) desktop, ±100% below 900px
motion.purpose: Hero curtain halves parting on load; removed under prefers-reduced-motion (halves rendered open).

motion.name: hero-in
motion.value: 1s ease-out 1s both; opacity 0 to 1, translateY(14px) to none
motion.purpose: Hero content arrives after the curtain; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.value: transform 0.25s ease-out, background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.25s ease-out
motion.purpose: Button, text-link and nav-ring state changes.

motion.name: focus-ring
motion.value: outline 3px solid #2b5da8, offset 3px, radius 2px; #ffffff inside the rail, action bar and footer

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Three-up and four-up grids fall to two columns.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Rows, location grid, steps and duo go single column; go-rows stack description under title; nav wraps onto a second row, hero stacks, curtain exits fully, mobile action bar appears.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: All grids single column; facts stack key over value; buttons may wrap; epigraph gains side padding.

textures.name: curtain-ground
textures.purpose: Body background over #9db09a, background-attachment: fixed; the 72px pleat pitch is --pleat.

textures.name: curtain-halves
textures.purpose: The parting halves over #7f9480 (--p: 34px), masked to transparent over the bottom 20%.

textures.name: perforation
textures.purpose: 14px strip at the top of every sheet and slip.

textures.name: perforation-caption
textures.purpose: 10px strip at the top of the hero photo's paper caption.

pages.index: Home (slim front door: hero, argument sheet, epigraph, door rows, teaser duo, closing band)
pages.contatti: Contatti (Dove e contatti: booking, location sheets, online bay, first-visit checklist, emergency notice)
pages.unusedCss: .plaque*, .plaques, .stages, .conditions, .condition-group, .conditions-foot, .location .plate; .perche already gone; not documented as system parts
pages.navState: Each page marks its own rail item aria-current=page; footer nav never marked
pages.bookingExits: MioDottore profile, tel: links, own pages; maps and practice sites on dove-ricevo only

accessibility: Text on the sage curtain is Ink #1f2b23 (6.4:1 on #9db09a); white text is confined to the dark fitting #2f3f34 (11.2:1).
Scrub blue is reserved for actions, so colour alone never carries meaning elsewhere.
Global :focus-visible ring 3px #2b5da8 at 3px offset; white inside the rail, action bar and footer.
Mobile nav wraps onto two rows instead of scrolling; no content is hidden behind a mask.
Minimum targets: pills 54px, small pill and nav 44px, action bar 50px.
External links carry the ext icon plus visually hidden '(si apre in una nuova pagina)' where needed.
prefers-reduced-motion removes the curtain and hero animations and renders the curtain open.
Emergency notice band carries no buttons; opening hours are never invented (agenda link only).
Content readable without JavaScript; images carry descriptive Italian alt text.

Valentina Tanga

narrative.overview:
The site is the pain therapist's treatment room, built from its three materials. A pleated hospital curtain in soft sage is the ground of every page: it never gives way to a white canvas, its vertical pleats run behind everything that is not paper, and text sits on it in ink, dark on light, as on a chart pinned to the fabric. Reading happens on paper-white sheets torn off the examination bed's roll, each with a perforated top edge, laid over the curtain one after another down the page. Scrub blue appears only where the visitor acts (book, call, open a map); it is never a heading, a rule, or an ornament. A brushed-steel rail runs across the top of the room on the one dark green surface and carries the navigation on small rings; the footer and the phone's action bar are the same dark fitting. The homepage is a slim front door (the argument, one quotation, three doors to the inner pages, two teasers, the booking band) and the four-page site is read through it.

The register is serious, plain and reassuring. Type is a condensed signage system (Barlow Condensed caps for labels, Barlow Semi Condensed for the hook, headings and buttons) set against a wide, quiet reading face (Source Sans 3) at a large body size, because the readers are often in pain, older, and on a phone in the evening. Density is low: one argument per bay, generous paper margins, 66-character measures, and one quotation given its own quiet band on the curtain. Motion is a single theatrical gesture, the curtain halves parting on load, and nothing else moves except a button lifting a pixel.

The world rejects the medical-site default of a white page, a smiling-doctor hero, a blue accent everywhere and three icon cards. Photographs are the three client-approved pictures of the doctor at work, used as prints with a paper caption or as tall portraits, never as stock or background imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Sage curtain (`#9db09a`) is the page ground on every surface, read in ink (`#1f2b23`); paper sheets (`#f7f5f0`) carry all running copy.
The dark green (`#2f3f34`) is a fitting, not a ground: rail, footer and mobile action bar, always with white text.
Scrub blue (`#2b5da8`) is reserved for actions and inline links; it appears nowhere decorative.
Brushed steel (a white-to-grey vertical gradient) is the only metal: the rail's top edge and the action bar's top edge.
Three self-hosted faces with a clear division of labour: Barlow Condensed caps for signage, Barlow Semi Condensed for headings and sentence-case pill buttons, Source Sans 3 for reading.
Paper edges are perforated (sage dots on a 14px pitch) wherever paper meets curtain.
Depth is physical: one long soft shadow under lifted paper and photographs, a blue-tinted lift under the primary pill, a short hard drop under steel, none under text.
One choreographed motion (the curtain opening), fully disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

rules.name: The Scrub Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "act". It appears on primary buttons, inline links and the focus ring, and nowhere else: never on headings, rules, icons at rest, or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Paper for Reading Rule
rules.body: Running copy longer than one lead sentence lives on paper (`#f7f5f0`) with ink (`#1f2b23`). A green bay holds a heading, one lead sentence and an action; anything longer is laid on a paper slip. The epigraph is the one exception: a single quotation may stand on the curtain.

rules.name: The Ink on Sage Rule
rules.body: Text on the curtain is Ink, never white: the sage is light enough to be read like paper. White text exists only on the dark fittings (Rail), and nothing in the sage family is used as a surface for white text.

rules.name: The Signage Caps Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is always uppercase and tracked (0.06–0.1em) and is never used for running text or on buttons; Source Sans 3 is never uppercase or tracked. Buttons are Barlow Semi Condensed in sentence case, the same face as the headings.

rules.name: The One Hook Rule
rules.body: Display size exists once per page, for the hero hook on the homepage or the page title on an inner page; sections open with Headline and never with a label above the heading.

rules.name: The Lifted Paper Rule
rules.body: Only things that physically sit on the curtain cast a shadow: paper, photographs, steel and the blue pill. Nothing on paper casts a shadow onto paper; hierarchy inside a sheet is done with rules, type and whitespace.

rules.name: The Fixed Pleat Rule
rules.body: The curtain texture is `background-attachment: fixed` so sheets scroll over a still curtain. Any new ground surface must keep the same four gradient layers and the 72px pleat pitch over Sage.

dos: **Do** keep the sage curtain as the ground of every page and let it show between sheets; a new page starts from `#9db09a` with the four fixed pleat layers, never from white.
**Do** set text on the curtain in Ink (`#1f2b23`), and reserve white text for the dark fittings (`#2f3f34`: rail, footer, action bar).
**Do** put any copy longer than one lead sentence on paper (a sheet or a slip) in Ink; keep green bays to heading, lead and action.
**Do** give every paper edge that meets the curtain the 14px perforation strip of Sage dots.
**Do** use Scrub Blue only for primary pills, inline links and the focus ring; keep ghost pills Ink-stroked (White only inside the action bar).
**Do** build buttons as 54px pills in Barlow Semi Condensed sentence case with the icon in a tinted circle at the trailing end (leading for the phone).
**Do** set labels, nav and `h3` in Barlow Condensed uppercase tracked 0.06–0.1em, headings in Barlow Semi Condensed 600, and everything readable in Source Sans 3 at 1.125rem/1.6 on a 66ch measure.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px or more (54px pills, 44px small pills and nav, 50px on the action bar) and keep the fixed action bar on every page below 900px.
**Do** mark external links with the `#i-ext` icon and visually hidden text, and show the phone number as digits in the call button.
**Do** open every inner page with a page head directly on the curtain (Page title, optional byline, 1.3rem lead) and close it with a green band.
**Do** use definition rows for lists of treatments and credentials, and facts lists for a practice's address, phone and site.
**Do** keep every booking action pointing at MioDottore, the phone, or the site's own pages, and let the emergency notice band stand without buttons.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by removing both hero animations and rendering the curtain open.
donts: **Don't** use Scrub Blue, or any other saturated colour, for headings, rules, icons at rest or backgrounds.
**Don't** put white text on any sage (`#9db09a`, `#7f9480`) or use the dark green as a page ground.
**Don't** put shadows under elements that sit on paper, or under text; only paper, photographs, steel and the blue pill cast shadows.
**Don't** set buttons in uppercase or in Barlow Condensed; signage caps are for labels, never for pills.
**Don't** add a second accent, a kicker above headings, or a display-size setting outside the hero hook and the inner-page title.
**Don't** put a button beside the emergency notice, or add display-size type to an inner page beyond the one title.
**Don't** invent opening hours or claim mechanisms or comparisons for a therapy; copy stays descriptive and points to the visit and the MioDottore agenda.
**Don't** make the homepage a long brochure: it points to the inner pages with door rows and teasers rather than repeating their content.
**Don't** use stock photography, decorative anatomy, or icon cards; the only images are the client-approved photographs with their provenance sidecars.
**Don't** round corners beyond 4px except on pills; the only circles are the button icon discs and the nav rings.
**Don't** use steel greys as text colours, or steel anywhere other than the rail and the action bar's edge.
